sourceNotes: The Sting action uses the 5-ft. reach printed on Spanish p. 344. Its saving throw and the separate 10-ft. Reflexive Sting trigger continue on p. 345. BFRD v0.2 prints a 10-ft. Sting action, which belongs to that separate publication.
